term: A7 at-least-n to at-least-(n−1) possible-causation transfer
definition: `CountDescent C` is the universal conditional `∀ n : Nat, 1 < n → C n → C (n - 1)`. This is about possible causation of separate situations, not about arithmetic inclusion of the sets of individuals those situations describe.
note: Faithful conditional extraction of the specialized A7c step 2, not an independently warranted metaphysical principle. An explicit source claim records why it appears in the argument.
